hero.subtitle: Plan classes, assess your students, automate tasks, and make the most of artificial intelligence to spend more time teaching. Start free.
hero.trustNote: Free · No credit card · Ready in 2 min

funcionalidades.introSubtitle: A platform designed around teachers' real work.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Conceptual architecture designed to separate and organize your teaching life.
bullets: A personal space for your teaching work.
Institutional spaces to work alongside your school.
You can belong to several workspaces.
Your personal information always stays with you.
Each workspace keeps its own context, information and permissions.

repository.title: Repository
repository.highlight: All your teaching work. In one place.
repository.description: Your teaching work shouldn't be scattered across folders, chats and emails.
bullets: Centralized repository of resources and documents.
Version control, history and traceability.
Flows compatible with quality processes and ISO.
Share only what you need.

teams.title: Teams
teams.highlight: Work with the people you need.
teams.description: Not just a chat group: a true collaborative space with workflow control.
bullets: Research seedbeds and study groups.
Academic areas and institutional committees.
Projects and collaborative work teams.
Effective control of workflows and working roles.

classes.title: Classes
classes.highlight: Everything that happens in the classroom.
classes.description: The teacher's daily operating space that brings group management together.
bullets: Lesson planning and sequencing.
Attendance and grade tracking.
Announcement board and activities.
Comprehensive follow-up for each student and the group.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.highlight: All your communication, in one place.
inbox.description: An inbox built for teaching work, not another informal messaging app.
bullets: Communicate with your teams and other teachers.
Connect with the Lenio user community.
Messages strictly related to your work.

builder.title: Format builder
builder.highlight: Create exactly the formats you need.
builder.description: A reusable visual editor like Word / Canva designed for school documents.
bullets: Design memos, lesson plans and rubrics.
Assessment formats, reports and forms.
Create a format once, then reuse or modify it.
Generate one-off instances or documents.

ai.title: AI Agents
ai.description: AI contextualized to teachers' real work, with memory of your environment.
bullets: Continuous contextual memory across your personal and institutional space.
It understands your classes, history, repository and past documents.
Specialized agents: Planner, Assessor, Activities and Feedback.
Aligned with your school's context and the national curriculum framework.

agenda.title: Agenda
agenda.highlight: Your time belongs to the workspace too.
agenda.description: Each workspace keeps its own agenda to manage time in an orderly way.
bullets: View your schedule and commitments.
Create events and organize activities.
Manage institutional workspace events.
Independent calendar contexts.

cta.title: Start using Lenio today
cta.subtitle: Lenio is the platform designed to empower teachers' work, bring teams together and support quality processes. Create your personal space in minutes and connect with features built to transform your daily work.
